```plato

//==
// # The linear system and its solution
//
// The assembled system is a `SparseMatrix` (`matrices.types.plato`) in
// coordinate-list form, and it is solved by a preconditioned conjugate gradient
// that never indexes it. See the library's "Assembly" section for why those two
// choices belong together.

// When a conjugate-gradient solve stops: after MaxIterations sweeps, or once the
// residual norm has fallen to Tolerance times its starting value, whichever
// comes first. Tolerance is a RELATIVE residual, so it is independent of the
// units the loads are stated in.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conjugate_gradient_method)
type LinearSolveSettings
    implements IValue
{
    MaxIterations: Integer;
    Tolerance: Number;
}
```
